name: MegaMenu
label: Mega menu
description: A wide navigation panel of icon rows with descriptions, beside an optional featured card.

props.name: open
props.description:
Whether the panel shows. Controlled by design: the host owns the
triggers that open it, so it owns this state too. A closed panel fades
out and is `inert`, so its links leave the tab order.

props.name: items
props.description:
The link rows, in columns of at least four. A column grows taller before
the grid adds one, up to three columns beside a showcase and four without.

props.name: showcase
props.description: A featured card in its own column beside the link grid.

props.name: currentHref
props.description:
The path of the page being viewed. A row whose `href` is this path, or a
parent of it, is marked as the current page.

props.name: onNavigate
props.description: Called when any link in the panel is followed, so a host can close it.

props.name: linkComponent
props.description:
The component every link renders through, so a router's link (Next.js
`Link`) navigates without a reload. The panel is server-renderable, so it
cannot read a `LinkProvider`; a client host resolves one and passes it
here. Defaults to `<a>`.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes on the panel.

LinkComponent.description: A component that renders a link in place of a plain `<a>`, such as a router's.

LinkComponentProps.description:
The props a link component receives: every anchor attribute, the ref, and
an `href` that is always a string. Next.js's `Link` takes these as they
are; a router whose link takes `to` instead needs a one-line adapter:
`({ href, ...props }) => <RouterLink to={href} {...props} />`.

MegaMenuItem.description: One link row in a mega menu: a page and the line that says what is on it.

MegaMenuShowcase.description: The featured card beside a mega menu's link grid: one link that is the whole card.
